item.text:
The `GET /v1/audio/voices` list-voices endpoint takes these paging query parameters:

- `limit` — maximum number of voices to return
- `offset` — pagination offset

It also accepts `type` for filtering (`all`, `custom`, or `preset`). [Mistral Audio Voices API documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/audio/voices)
